choices.A: Two triangles with equal areas are congruent
choices.B: Two triangles with equal perimeters are congruent
choices.C: Two figures that can be made to coincide exactly are congruent
choices.D: Two figures with the same shape are congruent

question: Which of the following statements is correct?
solution: Congruent figures are defined as figures that can be made to coincide exactly. Equal areas, equal perimeters, or the same shape do not guarantee that the figures can coincide exactly.
